sources.title: Publishing on crates.io
sources.finding: Publishing creates an immutable package version and requires authenticated registry access; published dependency versions and included files must be intentional.

sources.title: npm trusted publishing
sources.finding: Trusted publishing needs Node 22.14+ and npm 11.5.1+. Exact repository/workflow/environment settings and allowed publish actions matter. New configurations need a successful publish within two days. Automatic provenance requires a public package and public source repository.

sources.title: npm trust command
sources.finding: Owner-side CLI setup can configure a GitHub trusted publisher with the repository, workflow filename, environment and allow-publish permission; account authentication and 2FA remain owner actions.

sources.title: GitHub deployments and environments
sources.finding: Environment protection availability depends on repository visibility and account plan. The private repository's required-reviewer API returned 422; no reviewer gate is claimed.

note: Primary sources were checked online. Live registry availability, GitHub administration and deployed bytes are separately recorded observations, not inferred from documentation.
